**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.** No blockers. This is a `feat` PR, so it merges at the next cut.

Reviewer record: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4301#issuecomment-7210351123

## Scope

- The PR adds `rename_operation`, `edit_tool` and `set_work_material` to `CORE_TOOLS` (`crates/app/src/mcp/provider.rs:33-34`). The core set goes from 25 to 28 tools.
- The three tools exist in the live MCP registry. No tool implementation, validation, confirmation rule or undo command changes.
- The PR does not change posted G-code, gouge or collision checks, stock simulation or geometry. This is not a safety-tier review.
- The `crates/ui` change is a test file only (`tests/ai_chat/budget.rs`). No visible UI changes, so no screenshots are necessary.
- No `testdata/`, importer, post, catalog or recorded-program change. No goldens moved.

## What looks good

- `every_live_tool_maps_without_schema_loss` now checks the Full and the Core sets in all four provider formats against the live registry.
- The new panel test `a_local_native_rename_changes_the_document_and_undo_turn_restores_it` runs the rename through the real worker and the live MCP inbox. It checks the label, the stable key, the tool result, one history entry, and Undo Turn.
- `edit_tool` and `set_work_material` are not on the read-only allow-list (`crates/app/src/mcp/fallback.rs:68`). Prompt-JSON mode thus asks for user confirmation before it runs them.
- The decision file `docs/decisions/3546-chat-core-tools.md` gives what was chosen, why, and what was dropped.
- The body has `Changelog:`, `Fixes #3546` and a conventional subject. It is not a process change.

## Results (locally, trial merge with upstream/main `9b141e1122fa`)

The PR head is already based on that main. The trial merge is a no-op.

Quick gate, `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 15 steps, 0 failed.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| app lib | 319 passed |
| app `mcp_compact` | 7 passed |
| app `mcp_doc_drift` | 9 passed |
| app `mcp_provider` | 9 passed |
| ui lib (software GPU adapter, llvmpipe) | 1722 passed, 8 ignored |
| ui `boundary`, `boundary_picks`, `contour_dxf_sketch`, `sinker_setup`, `tap_hand`, `theme_example`, `theme_files`, `waterjet_tool` | all passed |

- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Light lane, `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main`: 6 steps (11 light twins), 0 failed.

Extra suites run: none apply. The diff has no `testdata/` change and no importer change.

## Mutations (local only, reverted)

1. Remove `rename_operation` from `CORE_TOOLS`: red. `mcp_provider` gives `Core lacks rename_operation`. `mcp_compact` fails the count of 28. The ui test `a_local_model_gets_the_core_tool_set...` gives `local payload lacks rename_operation`. The ui rename test gives `rename must be offered`.
2. Remove `set_work_material` from `CORE_TOOLS`: red. `mcp_provider` gives `Core lacks set_work_material`. `mcp_compact` fails the count of 28.

After the revert, the tests are green again.

## Optional, non-blocking

1. `crates/app/src/mcp/provider.rs:33-34`: the two changed lines are about 120 characters long. The rest of the list wraps near 100. `rustfmt` is not in the gate, so this is style only.
2. A fact from mutation 1: with `rename_operation` removed from the offered set, the scripted native call still renamed the operation. The panel worker runs any registry tool that the model names. It does not check the call against the offered set. This is not a change of this PR. `Core` is a context-budget subset, not a permission set (cloud models get the full table), and each tool is one undoable command. A follow-up can decide if a native call outside the offered set must be refused (suggested `P7`).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
